verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a payments API platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows only SDK release notes (mangopay-docs-36) and package names like 'mangopay4', which hint at versioned SDKs. Neither documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and they do not earn partial credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
